expectations.text: diagnoses-border-only: measured before async/streamed content laid out, offsetHeight returns only chrome/border (~2px)
expectations.evidence: TL;DR + Diagnosis explicitly name 'border-only measurement of ~2px', empty body on first commit, chrome border only.

expectations.text: uses-resizeobserver-settle: observe and take settled value, not a single mount read
expectations.evidence: ResizeObserver hook; commits only when stable across two consecutive RO deliveries ('settled' signal).

expectations.text: rejects-border-only-guard: refuses border-only/near-zero measurement
expectations.evidence: isTrustworthy() predicate rejects borderBoxH - chromeH <= 1 and implausible collapse; consumer gates badge on height != null.

expectations.text: handles-content-readiness: fonts/images cause late height change
expectations.evidence: Explains fonts swap + image decode; adds document.fonts.ready nudge for deterministic settle.

expectations.text: abandons-oneshot-mount: recognizes one-shot read is the root problem
expectations.evidence: 'Why measure at the right instant cant be the fix' section; replaces [] effect with observe-and-settle.

expectations.text: identifies-body-context-loss: body-append drops vars/theme classes/container ancestry
expectations.evidence: Lists lost custom properties, ancestor classes ([data-density], .dark), container-query context on document.body.

expectations.text: explains-container-query-break: container queries resolve against absent/wrong container off-body
expectations.evidence: Explains @container rules fail to match with no query container ancestor, flipping to default branch.

expectations.text: recommends-in-place-or-subtree: measure in place / probe inside real subtree / reproduce container+width
expectations.evidence: Best option = measure real rows in place with RO + cache; off-flow probe must mount inside real container subtree.

expectations.text: fixes-inline-size: measure at real inline size (height is function of width)
expectations.evidence: 'Pin the real inline size'; notes unconstrained absolute clone has wrong width -> wrong wrapping.

expectations.text: warns-copy-computed: dont snapshot getComputedStyle; replicate ancestors
expectations.evidence: 'Do NOT clone getComputedStyle onto the probe. That freezes %/em/ch/fit-content and kills container queries.'

expectations.text: measures-without-height-zero: measure inner auto-height node, not the constrained animating element
expectations.evidence: Inner .auto-height__content stays height:auto in normal flow; RO observes it; container clips with overflow:hidden. Explicit 'measure the content, not the container'.

expectations.text: resizeobserver-changing-content: RO so height updates on reflow/async content
expectations.evidence: RO re-fires on resize rewrap, font swap, image load, async chunk; measuredHeight kept live even while closed.

expectations.text: animate-px-then-auto: handles height:auto animation correctly; accounts for auto after transition
expectations.evidence: Animates 0<->measured px; keeps px pinned + RO re-pin so growth isnt clipped; 'Two variations' discusses switching to height:auto after open transition tradeoff.

expectations.text: correct-measure-timing: useLayoutEffect/rAF/RO, Math.ceil to avoid clipping
expectations.evidence: useIsoLayoutEffect shim; Math.ceil on committed height; borderBoxSize preferred (reflow-free, transform-safe).

expectations.text: diagnoses-border-only: measured before async/streamed content laid out, offsetHeight returns only chrome/border (~2px)
expectations.evidence: Timeline explains 2px = chrome top+bottom border with empty body on first commit.

expectations.text: uses-resizeobserver-settle: observe and take settled value, not a single mount read
expectations.evidence: useMeasuredHeight uses ResizeObserver updating on initial box + every reflow; no explicit stability/settle check but not a one-shot read.

expectations.text: rejects-border-only-guard: refuses border-only/near-zero measurement
expectations.evidence: No validity predicate; setHeight(h) commits whatever RO reports. Suggests min-height reserve but no reject-garbage guard on the consumer side.

expectations.text: handles-content-readiness: fonts/images cause late height change
expectations.evidence: Discusses web-font swap + image decode; recommends aspect-ratio, font-display, preload.

expectations.text: abandons-oneshot-mount: recognizes one-shot read is the root problem
expectations.evidence: Identifies [] one-shot as root cause; also offers CSS-first alternative (badge via top/right needs no measurement).

expectations.text: identifies-body-context-loss: body-append drops vars/theme classes/container ancestry
expectations.evidence: Sections 1-2 cover lost container queries and inherited custom properties; compact density driven by variable overrides.

expectations.text: explains-container-query-break: container queries resolve against absent/wrong container off-body
expectations.evidence: Section 1 explains @container resolves against nearest container ancestor, none under body -> default branch, shorter box.

expectations.text: recommends-in-place-or-subtree: measure in place / probe inside real subtree / reproduce container+width
expectations.evidence: Strategy A reproduces container chain (mount inside theme root); Strategy B measures real rows on mount + cache.

expectations.text: fixes-inline-size: measure at real inline size (height is function of width)
expectations.evidence: Section 3 'Width is unconstrained'; setWidth pins container to real content width.

expectations.text: warns-copy-computed: dont snapshot getComputedStyle; replicate ancestors
expectations.evidence: Advocates replicating ancestors (clone container chain, carry classes/data-* attrs) rather than snapshotting styles; does not use getComputedStyle copy. (Weaker: never explicitly names the getComputedStyle-freeze pitfall.)

expectations.text: measures-without-height-zero: measure inner auto-height node, not the constrained animating element
expectations.evidence: Two-element outer clipper + inner content; RO observes inner content at natural height; 'if you put both jobs on one element youre back to fighting the browser'.

expectations.text: resizeobserver-changing-content: RO so height updates on reflow/async content
expectations.evidence: RO subscribed to inner content while open; re-pins height on any size change; table row 'Content changes while open'.

expectations.text: animate-px-then-auto: handles height:auto animation correctly; accounts for auto after transition
expectations.evidence: Explains cant transition to/from auto, feeds pixel value; keeps px-pinned deliberately, discusses tradeoff of not snapping to auto (notes/trade-offs).

expectations.text: correct-measure-timing: useLayoutEffect/rAF/RO, Math.ceil to avoid clipping
expectations.evidence: useIsomorphicLayoutEffect; getBoundingClientRect fractional to avoid 1px clip; borderBoxSize for transform safety. (No Math.ceil, but uses fractional read.)
